Compares multiple visibility algorithms for symbol table construction and analyzes their performance.

# Purpose
The code is a script designed to compare different visibility algorithms used in symbol table construction for programming projects. It processes files within a specified project directory, grouping them by programming language, and applies multiple visibility algorithms to analyze and compare the results. The script uses the `argparse` module to handle command-line arguments, allowing users to specify the project path and optionally select specific algorithms for comparison.

The script's main function, [`run_multi_algorithm_comparison`](<#run_multi_algorithm_comparison>), executes the visibility algorithms on the files, collects results, and compares them against a baseline algorithm, which is the Depth-First Search (DFS) algorithm. It reports any discrepancies in the visibility maps and provides performance metrics, such as computation times and speedup factors. The script also outputs detailed statistics on the number of files processed and dependencies found. The [`main`](<#main>) function serves as the entry point, parsing command-line arguments and invoking the comparison function with the appropriate parameters.
